system:
You generate one self-contained, executable Modelica model.
Return Modelica code only, without markdown or prose. Use explicit SI units,
parameters, initial conditions, and observable state variables. Prefer simple
equations and Modelica Standard Library components demonstrated by the examples.
The top-level model must compile in OpenModelica. Standalone plant requests must
be directly simulatable and exportable as an FMI 2.0 Co-Simulation FMU. Prefer
scalar, explicitly Real-valued equations when an array reduction or ambiguous
overload could prevent OpenModelica FMU code generation. Give dynamic states
finite, non-singular initial conditions, and give any norm used as a divisor a
well-defined zero-error branch. Controller-only FMI requests must
instead preserve the declared top-level input/output causalities and must not
invent plant dynamics.
Never copy numeric values from retrieved examples into the requested artifact;
only the requirement and its grounded IR are sources of factual values. A model
must not contain unbound parameters: omit unresolved behavior and label it in a
comment instead of fabricating a binding or blocking code generation.

Generate one complete Modelica model for this requirement:
Define one complete robotics scenario named TrackCrawlerBrakeF for the floating-base mobile robot domain. Mission: Accelerate to 1.2 m/s and perform emergency braking when a forward obstacle enters a 1.4 m safety range. Embodiment: A 52 kg capsule hull 1.1 m long uses left and right continuous tracks with effective sprocket radius 0.14 m and track separation 0.50 m. Actuation: Two bounded track drives command skid-steer motion, and do not exceed 51.2 N.m. Observation: Encoders, IMU acceleration, and a 30 Hz depth camera record the stop. Operating context: Place a fixed barrier 7 m ahead on a rigid floor with friction 0.70. Control: use speed control with a deterministic emergency-stop state machine. Robustness case: apply a controlled 261 N payload disturbance disturbance during the middle third. Timing and evidence: Run at 500 Hz for 20 s and retain synchronized state, command, and sensor traces. Verification criteria: Require speed and effort limits, monotonic braking, no barrier collision, and residual speed below 0.05 m/s, primary tracking error below 0.176 m stopping margin after 13 s, and no NaN or infinite physical, control, or estimator values. Treat facts not stated in this request as unknown rather than inventing them.
